title: Driven by Insight, Powered by Culture: How P&G Serves Hispanic Consumers and Communities
summary: How P&G supports U.S. Hispanic communities through employee-led innovation, consumer-inspired brand experiences, and community partnerships.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


***How does P&G support Hispanic employees?*** P&G works to foster a culture of belonging where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives, grow, and thrive. Employee affinity groups, including P&G’s Hispanic Leadership Network, help build connections, support professional growth, and create opportunities for employees and allies to share experiences and perspectives that strengthen our teams and business.


***How does P&G serve U.S. Hispanic consumers?*** P&G works to better understand U.S. Hispanic consumers by listening to their needs and experiences and using those insights to inform innovation, brand experiences, and storytelling across brands including Crest, Gain, Head & Shoulders, and Tide. Hispanic employees, P&G brands, and community partners all contribute to how P&G serves consumers year-round.


***How does P&G support Hispanic communities?*** P&G works with trusted organizations on programs that support Hispanic communities and expand opportunities for the next generation. These include partnerships such as the[NFL Latino Youth Honors](https://www.nfl.com/causes/latino-youth-honors/) , presented by P&G in partnership with the[NFL](https://www.nfl.com/videos/2026-latino-youth-honors-sizzle) and[Hispanic Heritage Foundation](https://hispanicheritage.org/) .


***How does P&G celebrate Hispanic Heritage Month?*** P&G’s work to understand and serve U.S. Hispanic consumers and communities extends throughout the year. Hispanic Heritage Month provides an opportunity to recognize and spotlight that ongoing work through employee programming, brand experiences, and community partnerships, including LatinOvation, P&G’s internal Hispanic employee event


***How can I learn more about P&G’s support of Hispanic communities?*** Learn more about P&G’s ongoing work with U.S. Hispanic consumers, employees, and communities on our[website](https://us.pg.com/racial-and-ethnic-inclusion/) .
